## Description

Formulates portfolio rebalancing with transaction cost constraints into Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) problems solved via quantum adiabatic theorem and quantum annealers.

## Where it may fit

Large-scale institutional rebalancing with discrete asset selection and non-linear transaction cost penalties.

## Vehicles

Institutional Quantitative Funds, Advanced Portfolio Management Desks.

## Required data

Expected asset returns, asset covariance matrices, transaction cost fee schedules, turnover limits.

## Caveats

Limited qubit connectivity on current NISQ hardware requires problem graph embedding heuristics.
